toolRestriction.reason: the tool restriction of F120-FR-024 is environmental: the hermetic PATH of a case carries a stub specstride whose launch refuses (rc.8 shows no tool-restriction flag; src/host-facts.ts HF-15); no case can launch a run even if a model tries

invoked-skill.method: grade the session log for the expected skill load
invoked-skill.reads: the JSONL session log resolved from the hermetic DSH_HOME (HF-08)
invoked-skill.passes: a tool/call of tool skill names the expected skill, or a <skill_content name="..."> of it is injected

no-skill-invoked.method: grade the session log for an absent skill load
no-skill-invoked.reads: the JSONL session log resolved from the hermetic DSH_HOME (HF-08)
no-skill-invoked.passes: no skill tool call and no skill-content injection appear

no-launch.method: read the recorded tool calls of the run
no-launch.reads: the recorded tool calls (stubSuiteRunner result or the session log)
no-launch.passes: no recorded tool call launches a specstride run
